```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE)

# Load the required packages
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(
  rio, here, tidyverse, knitr, kableExtra,
  skimr, RColorBrewer, viridis, DT, flexdashboard,
  formatR, gridExtra, janitor, ggplot2, ggpubr, cowplot, 
  gghighlight, ggokabeito
)

# Import the clean NHANES dataset
nhanes_data <- import(here("data", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"))
```

Row {data-height=650}
---------------------------------

### Age distribution

```{r age, echo = FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(here("figures", "age_distribrution.png"))
```

```{r prepare-age, echo = FALSE}
# Calculate percentage of participants 21 ot older
percent_21_plus <- nhanes_data %>%
  summarise(
    percentage = mean(age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  pull(percentage)
```

Row {data-height=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Percentage of Participants Aged 21 or Older

```{r percent-age, echo=FALSE}
gauge(
  round(percent_21_plus, 1),
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  sectors = gaugeSectors(
    success = c(75, 100),
    warning = c(50, 75),
    danger = c(0, 50)
  )
)
```

```{r prepare-sbp, echo = FALSE}
# Create average Systolic blood pressure
nhanes_data <- nhanes_data %>%
  mutate(
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(
      select(., systolic_bp_1, systolic_bp_2, systolic_bp_3, systolic_bp_4),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    avg_sbp = ifelse(is.nan(avg_sbp), NA, avg_sbp)
  )
# Percentage of participants whose average SBP is greater than 120 mm Hg
percent_sbp_120 <- nhanes_data %>%
  summarise(
    percentage = mean(avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  pull(percentage)
```

### Participants with Average SBP > 120 mm Hg

```{r sbp120, echo=FALSE}
valueBox(
  paste0(round(percent_sbp_120, 1), "%"),
  caption = "Average SBP above 120 mm Hg",
  color = "info"
)
```
